name: The Rachel Maddow Show
description: The Rachel Maddow Show is a daily news and opinion television program that airs on MSNBC, running in the 9:00 pm ET timeslot. It is hosted by Rachel Maddow, who gained popularity with her frequent appearances as a liberal pundit on various MSNBC programs. It is based on her former radio show of the same name. The show debuted on September 8, 2008.

videos.title: Why We Did It
videos.overview: Political commentator and author Rachael Maddow offers an investigation into what spurred the U.S. government to enter the Iraq war.
